info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account API
Returns Account Activity details by the parameters passed.

params.name: testName
params.description: Account activity for the Test Name

params.name: networkTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of Network Types (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: testTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of Test Types (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: monitorTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of Monitor Types (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: divisionId
params.description: Account Activity for the Division ID

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum value is 100.
